source.description: The existing 139-mesh MPI 35 Series presentation study, prepared for native Annora Explorer.
source.note: Not MPI engineering CAD or a PAC machine. Geometry and material colors are preserved; two image appearances and decorative line overlays are omitted. Motion is an authored explanatory preview, not cycle time or safety validation.
